messages.content: Can you help me Get object descriptors related to a domain example.org on VirusTotal? The relationship I want to check is subdomains. You should just return the related object's IDs (and context attributes, if any) instead of returning all attributes. My key is my_api. Set the limit to 10 and the continuation cursor to abc.

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to make live calls to the VirusTotal API (or any other external service).  
To obtain the sub‑domain objects for `example.org` yourself, you would normally send a request similar to this:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/example.org/relationships/subdomains
    ?limit=10&cursor=abc
Authorization: Bearer <your_api_key>
Accept: application/json
```

Replace `<your_api_key>` with your real key (`my_api`).  

The response will contain a list of object descriptors – each descriptor includes at least the object’s ID and may include additional “context_attributes” describing the relationship type (“subdomain”, etc.). If you run into trouble parsing the JSON or handling pagination, let me know and I’ll walk you through it!
